odc_type: incorrect boundary condition in character escaping logic
observation_summary: The compiler emitted the non-printable control character U+007f as a raw character in the generated JavaScript output instead of an escaped sequence.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by an incorrect range check in the character escaping logic within the CodeGenerator class. The code was intended to treat non-printable ASCII characters as needing escape sequences. The condition 'c <= 0x7f' incorrectly included the character U+007f (the 'delete' control character) as a printable character, allowing it to be emitted raw in the output. The fix changed the condition to 'c < 0x7f', ensuring that U+007f is correctly identified as a non-printable character and escaped, consistent with other control characters.
